name: DK_Youthful Campus Style_Campus Portrait Generation
description: Youthful Campus Style LIKE THIS MODEL? GIVE A ❤️ Model Introduction This LoRA model focuses on youthful campus themes, capable of generating characters in school uniforms, presenting diverse poses and atmospheres in campus scenes with vivid details and a strong youthful vibe. The model has good generalization and can be applied to various creative needs such as campus portraits and youth story scenes. Base Prompt: Same person in school uniform The red keywords serve as the base prompt​​, followed by character or scene descriptions, which can be expressed in either tag-based language or natural language. Example prompts used: Same person in school uniform , capturing playful poses under warm sunlight, with a retro film filter, showing youthful vitality in a campus setting. Same person in school uniform , sitting by the fence, gentle breeze tousling hair, soft natural light creating a serene and nostalgic atmosphere. Same person in school uniform , holding small items, dynamic postures, bright outdoor background, highlighting lively campus daily life. Same person in school uniform , different expressions—from pensive to cheerful, in a sunny outdoor scene, telling a story of emotions.
